summary: Recognize native enemy loot in acquisition on Factorio 2.0 and older targets.
details: Enemy drops use the selected engine's native identity, count and probability fields. Earlier LootItem declarations can supply an item acquisition seed, including the Factorio 2.0 pentapod egg; Factorio 2.1 keeps its item-product contract.
Foreign declaration fields cannot supply an identity or revive a zero-count drop. Native default counts and probability remain usable, and fluid identities cannot act as placement items.

Controlled canonical lab and source-epoch checks exercise the nine line contracts and prototype immutability. Native combat, world placement, drop quantities, progression, catalogue and saved-world behavior remain unqualified; no new permission, owner or support claim is granted.
